verdict.rationale: The core stack components appear self-hostable: Grafana OSS/Enterprise docs and the GitHub repo cover the UI, Loki can run in monolithic single-binary mode, and Mimir and Tempo have their own docs. Loki's docs explicitly cover migrating from previous deployments and upgrading. However, the evidence only shows architecture and upgrade guidance for Loki, and SLO, incident response and Adaptive Telemetry are documented only under Grafana Cloud, so the 'full stack' self-hosted claim is caveated. Missing for 10: documented production architecture for Grafana, Mimir and Tempo; upgrade paths beyond Loki; evidence that Cloud-only features (SLO, incident/on-call) can be self-hosted; independent hands-on reports of running the stack self-hosted in production.
